purpose: Lawful freeware corpus acquisition manifest (GS-104 / BPTK-083): every entry resolves to a named source, a redistribution basis, a license, and a pinned sha256 so a rebuild is byte-stable. Payload byte stay out of git and stage outside the repository.
rule: Only DRM-free, offline, lawfully-redistributable payload is admitted.
Copy protection, online activation, and anti-cheat are detected and refused, never circumvented.
A payload whose byte hash differs from the pinned sha256 is refused, never used.
No game payload is committed to the repository.

record.title: PuTTY
record.redistribution_basis: The MIT license permits redistribution of the unmodified binary; the file is served by the project's own download mirror.
record.note: Graphical terminal client; exercises window, control, and network-free startup path.

record.title: Plink
record.redistribution_basis: The MIT license permits redistribution of the unmodified binary; the file is served by the project's own download mirror.
record.note: Console connection helper: the cleanest non-game startup path for the non-game runtime ladder (GS-107).

record.title: jq
record.redistribution_basis: The MIT license permits redistribution of the unmodified binary; the file is the project release asset.

record.title: 7-Zip extra

record.title: OpenTTD
